task: FV2-040 — Responsive client update banner on desktop
summary: A user-provided Windows screenshot showed the long release summary wrapping into a very tall, underlined column and pushing the workspace below the fold. The Flutter update banner now clamps its summary to two lines with ellipsis and explicitly disables text decoration; full release details remain available in the existing details sheet. Package-version fallback defaults were also synchronized with 1.0.35+68 after the release quality workflow exposed drift.

checks.observation: Before the fix, the new regression failed because maxLines was null. After the fix, a 1280×900 desktop layout at text scale 2.5 has a two-line summary, no text decoration, banner height below 220 px, and no Flutter exception.
